attr.title: Super Smash Bros. Melee (native)
attr.desc: Native reimplementation of Super Smash Bros. Melee, built on the doldecomp decompilation and rendered through Aurora on OpenGL ES.
attr.desc_md: Native reimplementation of *Super Smash Bros. Melee*, built on the [doldecomp/melee](https://github.com/doldecomp/melee) decompilation and rendered through [Aurora](https://github.com/encounter/aurora) on OpenGL ES. Port source: [zalo/melee](https://github.com/zalo/melee/tree/release).
attr.inst: Place your own legally-dumped Super Smash Bros. Melee US 1.02 GameCube disc image (.iso, .gcm, .ciso or .rvz) in the melee/assets directory.
attr.inst_md: Place your own legally-dumped *Super Smash Bros. Melee* US 1.02 (`GALE01`) GameCube disc image (`.iso`, `.gcm`, `.ciso` or `.rvz`) in `ports/melee/assets/`. Answer **Yes** at the memory-card prompt on first launch.
